relevant_developers: Gongyu Wang, Miguel Tairum, Utku Aydonat

Commit bad61b1463 changed ModelArgs initialization, likely triggering code paths that expose this latent dimension mismatch. Fix: Override self.dim in VisionModelArgs.__init__() or update all vision tests to use model_args.vision_dim explicitly.

notes: The failure occurs on the revert commit itself, which reverts the 'Modernize loop convert' changes.
